title: etherealhubcc INSTANT TP
features:
90+ features - the forge

please use bunni or velocity if not working.

Mining Features

Auto Swing - Automatically swings pickaxe

Auto Mine - Automatically mines nearest rocks

Teleport Methods - Smooth or Instant teleportation

Mine Positions - Underground, Top, or Side positioning

Rock Type Filtering - Select specific rock types to mine

Camera Lock to Rock - Keeps camera focused on current rock

Mining Zones - Restrict mining to selected areas

Fight Nearby Mobs - Attacks mobs within radius while mining

Ore Filtering - Mine only rocks containing selected ores

Skip Rocks Without Ore - Skips rocks that don't contain priority ores

Position Offsets - Custom X/Y/Z offset adjustments

Combat Features

Auto Go To Mob - Automatically targets and moves to mobs

Auto Dodge - Dodges above mob when it attacks

Auto Block - Blocks when mob is attacking

Combat Teleport - Smooth or Instant combat movement

Mob Positions - Normal, Underground, Top, or Side positioning

Mob Priority - Select specific mobs to target

Camera Lock to Mob - Keeps camera focused on target

Position Offsets - Custom X/Y/Z offset adjustments

Rotation Angles - Custom Pitch/Yaw/Roll angle control

Items & Shop

Auto Buy Pickaxes - Purchase pickaxes from shop

Auto Buy Potions - Maintains potion inventory

Auto Use Potions - Automatically drinks potions when inactive

Potion Selection - Choose which potions to buy/use

Configurable Amounts - Set buy and use quantities

Selling System

Auto Sell - Sells on interval or when inventory full

Ore Selection - Choose which ores to sell

Rune Selection - Choose which runes/materials to sell

Essence Selection - Sell by rarity tier

Sell Interval - Configurable timer (60-1800 seconds)

Manual Sell - Instant sell button

Forging System

Auto Forge - Automates melting, pouring, and hammering

Auto Melt - Skips melt minigame

Auto Pour - Skips pour minigame

Auto Hammer - Auto-completes hammer minigame

Advanced Forging - Custom ore selection (4 slots)

Fast Forge - Speed option

Item Type Selection - Weapon or Armor

ESP & Visuals

Rock ESP - Highlights rocks with customizable colors

Player ESP - See other players

Mob ESP - Highlights enemies

Ore ESP - Shows ores in rocks

Name Labels - Display names for all ESP types

Color Customization - Individual color pickers for each ESP type

Teleportation

Location Teleport - Teleport to NPCs and pickaxes

Global Teleport Method - Affects all teleport features

Cannon TP - Uses in-game cannon for long distance

Webhooks

Discord Notifications - Sends alerts when finding rare ores

Ore Selection - Choose which ores trigger notifications

Custom Embed Colors - Personalize notification appearance

Test Webhook - Verify webhook functionality

Detailed Info - Shows rarity, chance, and amount

Configuration

Save/Load Configs - Multiple configuration profiles

Auto Load - Automatically load selected config on startup

Config Management - Create, delete, and switch between configs

Settings Persistence - All settings saved across sessions
